10 · The app’s part

The app’s part: it knows PowerScale

1Scheduleapp
2Collectlibrary
3Fetchapp
4Save rawlibrary
5Compactapp
6Keep & expirelibrary
7Summarizelibrary
8Answeragent
The app
Knows PowerScale.
  • when to askone poll per source, every 5 seconds
  • how to askone request, 5 seconds at most
  • what a row meansthe compact builder: values + pointers
  • the store rulestwo folders, two keep times, one disk floor
The app never decides how a record is saved. It hands each slot to the library.
Library · footprintjs-datapipeline
Knows how to record.
  • one slot, one operationasked twice → the same receipt
  • savechecked, saved, and a receipt back
  • keep, then expireon time, and the receipt stays
  • summarize60 slots → one summary, gaps named
Built on footprintjs: every stage is recorded while it runs, not rebuilt afterwards.
Agent · the app’s agent, built with agentfootprint
Answers from the record.
  • picks a skillPowerScale: triage, inventory, protection
  • calls its toolseach result says what it checked
  • gives a standingknown · not sure · ask, and why
  • readsInfluxDB today; these summaries next
The standing is worked out by code from the run’s record, not guessed by the model.
APP · poll(slot)
poll({ runId, slotAt: "10:00:15" })
one poller per sourcesources start apart

asked again?the same receiptno second request
resolve→fetch→check→save
the four stages every collect runs · fetch calls the app · each stage is recorded

late?5 s or more after its slot
disk below floor?either store
refused: a failed receipt, no device call, no retry

5 s budget

out of time: nothing saved, “not collected”: a gap, never a zero

17 · Summary

Three owners, three jobs

The app
knows PowerScale
when to ask, how to ask, what a row means, and the store rules
footprintjs-datapipeline
knows how to record
one operation per slot, saved with a receipt, expired on time, summarized every 5 minutes
agent · agentfootprint
answers from the record
skills and tools, and a standing on every answer: known, not sure, ask, and why
Every step leaves a receiptrecorded while it runs (footprintjs), not rebuilt afterwards
A gap is named, never a zeronot collected · missing · invalid · empty, each with its reason
Every number traces backsummary → receipt → saved answer → the exact row
Every answer says how sure it isknown · not sure · ask, with the why
Built · switched off✓ Lightweight poller and its two stores✓ Receipts, named gaps, the trail back✓ 5-minute summaries with their trace✓ The agent’s skills and tools (live path)
Still to do○ Keep times + disk floor (in review)○ A full storage day on its own disk (running)○ Sealed bookkeeping (draft) · history length○ Summary worker · agent tool · switch on
